title: Engineering
summary: How the app is built where that has to hold.
description: Rules that hold across the whole code base.

requirements.text: The frontend is React and TypeScript in a Tauri 2 shell; SQLite runs in Rust and the frontend queries it through drizzle.
`bun run build` typechecks `src/`, lints everything and bundles, and fails on any type or lint error.
`bun test` checks the spec: schema, unique ids, references, histories, and that every `Spec:` citation in the code names a requirement.
CI runs `bun test` and `bun run build` on every push.
On every push to main, CI builds the app for every platform in `app.platforms` and publishes the builds to the `latest` release.
Frontend packages are installed only once they have been published for `deps.minimum-age`.
The macOS app is signed (ad hoc while there's no certificate), so macOS asks before letting it onto the local network instead of keeping it off without asking.

values.description: How long a package version must have been published before it is installed.
